anatomy: T-Rex: exactly two hind legs, two front arms SHORTER than his head; pterodactyl two legs two wings
motion_rule: the T-Rex acts in every beat and travels with his whole bulk, never reaching from a standing pose; the granny pterodactyl works huge at the lens from 5.05 on; the tiny arms fall short
camera_moves: low angle, camera always moving, new framing every beat: push on the cleaver, arc along the counter, whip back on the swing, low push as she lifts the slab, creep to his snout at the end
character: grumpy old T-Rex butcher, wrinkled hide, enormous head, tiny front arms, stained apron, sleeves rolled up over the tiny arms, one white daisy behind his ear
cast: one T-Rex butcher, one granny pterodactyl customer in a headscarf, huge at the lens; nobody else
props: ONE wooden market counter on the ground, one level; a single heaped mound of meat resting on it; one wooden sign, hand-drawn pictures only: two radishes crossed out, a chicken beside them, no letters no digits; one cleaver
environment: clear noon, open market row, bare wooden stalls, short grass underfoot; dust low
lighting: blazing noon sun overhead, bright throughout, hard crisp shadows, sun straight through the slab when she lifts it

audio.delivery: gravelly old male voice, market barker, steady 4.5 syllables per second, never hurried
audio.pronunciation: natural native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window, silence in wordless beats, the granny never speaks
audio.lip_sync: jaw works each syllable, mouth free of props while he speaks, voice always from the T-Rex
audio.sfx: cleaver thud 0.0;sign thump into meat 1.5;wet poke 5.05;wing flap 6.0;slab slap on counter 8.8

timeline.a: he swings the cleaver down through the mound with his whole bulk behind it, the counter jumping under the blow
he heaves the whole mound round to face camera, apron flapping, rolled sleeves shaking on the tiny arms
he drives the sign into the mound with his foot, stamping it deep; the pictures come up facing the lens
he strides the length of the counter, snout jabbing at the crossed-out radishes, a tiny arm churning air short of them
he swings his whole bulk back down the counter, snout landing on the drawn chicken
he throws his whole bulk back off the counter as the granny pterodactyl, huge at the lens in her headscarf, pokes one finger deep into the meat
he drives his bulk up the counter after the slab, neck craning, as she lifts it against the sun and turns it; the sun burns straight through it, his arms falling short
he drives his bulk down the counter after her, head leading, apron swinging off his chest
he lunges as she slaps the slab back onto the counter; the daisy drops from behind his ear onto the meat and she snatches it, huge at the lens

must_appear: the T-Rex acting in every beat, moving his whole bulk; arms shorter than his head; stained apron and rolled sleeves; daisy behind his ear; ONE counter with one mound of meat; sign with two crossed-out radishes and a chicken; granny pterodactyl in a headscarf huge at the lens
negative_prompt: cyrillic, letters, digits, written words, subtitles, watermark, night, dim light, dark scene, human hands, second dinosaur, extra limbs, extra legs, deformed anatomy, slow motion, slow speech, static camera, T-Rex standing still, reaching without moving his feet, T-Rex absent from frame, stacked trays, floating props, pterodactyl small in the background, accented Russian
